main.summary: Represents provider-neutral publication journal metadata without embedded payload bytes.

property.name: ItemInstanceToken
property.summary: Gets the catalog-owned item instance token associated with the journal.

property.name: ExpectedStateVersion
property.summary: Gets the expected transfer state version.

property.name: FailureCount
property.summary: Gets the number of recorded failures.

property.name: LastError
property.summary: Gets the most recent failure message.

property.name: FinalObject
property.summary: Gets the final object Blob reference, when present.

property.name: FinalStreamLength
property.summary: Gets the final stream length, when present.

property.name: Integrity
property.summary: Gets the server-authoritative ordered content integrity, when prepared.
